Manja zona koštanog edema interkondilarne eminencije tibije uz nekoliko malih subhondralnih
cista. Mala zona koštanog edema medijalnog platoa tibije. Rubna osteofitoza u sklopu
degenerativnih promjena.
Gotovo potpuni gubitak femoralne i tibijalne hrskavice medijalnog segmenta. Hondromalacija III
stupnja lateralnog segmenta.
Mali izljev u zglobu.
Stražnja vlakna prednjeg križnog ligamenta povišenog su intenziteta signala vjerojatno u sklopu
mukoidne degeneracije. Prednja vlakna urednog su intenziteta signala i prate se u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Kompleksna ruptura trupa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska ranijeg datuma. Ruptura moguće
zahvaća i meniskotibijalni ligament. Ekstruzija medijalnog meniska u području rupture izvan
zglobnog prostora.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture, uz degenerativne promjene.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament povišenog je intenziteta pri polazištu s femura, moguća distenzija.
Zona povišenog intenziteta signala između lat. kolat. ligamenta i tetive popliteusa - burzitis?.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Blaga entezopatija hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa. Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta patelarnog
ligamenta.
Mala poplitealna cista. Fabella.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Hondromalacija II do III stupnja
patelarne hrskavice.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs ve  medial menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Ön çapraz bağda hafif diffüz sinyal artışı ,arka çapraz bağ proksimal düzeyinde fokal sinyal artışı izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdak medial fasette fissur hattı,incelme  ve komşu kemikte kemik iliği ödemi izlendi(grade III kondromalazi).Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. [DATE]: MR Knie Links 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: Zie gescande aanvraag Diagnostische vraagstelling: Zie gescande aanvraag Bevindingen: Verdikt en zeer grillig voorkomen voorste kruisband, met DST gestegen T2-signaal met disruptie vezels proximale 3e. Beperkt botoedeem posterieur aspect laterale tibiaplateau . Uitgebreide gewrichtsuitstorting. Normaal voorkomende menisci . Licht verdikt voorkomen proximale mediale collaterale ligament, minimale vochtinfiltratie. Gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden met enkele diepe fissuren en subchondrale bot veranderingen bovenste 3e crista patellaris. Besluit: Ernstige distorsio van de linkerknie met: - Volledige scheur voorste kruisband; - Parti ële scheur mediaal collateraal ligament, graad 2. Voorafbestaand gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden graad 4.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten an der medialen Femurcondyle (Serie 4/ Image 19). Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokal tiefgreifender Knorpeldefekt an der medialen Patellafacette im mittleren Anteil (Serie 7/ Image 10). Kein vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Ödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und der Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Kein Gelenkerguss. Plica mediopatellaris (Typ B nach Sakakibara).

There is a significant, incompletely imaged knee joint effusion that is communicating with a large, tense looking non ruptured Baker's cyst that is measuring just over 8 cm in maximal craniocaudal dimension.  Degenerative maceration is noted throughout the posterior half of the medial meniscus, with medial extrusion at the level of the body, together with a small inferiorly displaced fragment that is best appreciated in the coronal plane. There is resultant bowing of an otherwise intact superficial MCL.  An undisplaced tear through the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus is also present, along with mucoid degeneration at the corresponding anterior horn.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, distal iliotibial band and the extensor tendons. No fracture or marrow infiltration.  Reasonably well-maintained lateral weightbearing and patellofemoral articular cartilage surfaces, diffuse grade 2 thinning of medial weightbearing articular cartilage noted. Focal subcortical cystic change noted at the tibial aspect of the medial tibiofemoral joint line, presumed reactive in nature given the overlying extensive degenerative maceration.  Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Osseous contusions involving the sulcus terminalis and posterolateral tibial plateau as well as the posterior medial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete tear of the midsubstance.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Low grade 2 sprain pattern with partial tear of the deep fibers.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Recent pivot shift contusions with complete rupture of the midsubstance of the ACL and low grade 2 sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

MRI of left  Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

> Massive Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; mild hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Mild increased signal intensity of the articular cartilage of lateral facet patella on F/S T2WI, R/O grade 1 chondromalacia.
> The contour of ACL and MCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, R/O grade 1-2 injury.
> The contour of PCL and LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.

Impression: 
1. Massive Joint effusion and mild synovitis of left knee joint, nature unknown? R/O inflammatory arthritis.
2. Grade 1 patellar chondromalacia.
3. R/O grade 1-2 injury of ACL and MCL.
4. Patellar plicae.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and follow up

Indication: Right knee pain

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:

Medial compartment cartilage: Chondral thinning within the medial tibiofemoral compartment without focal articular cartilage defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Chondral thinning and partial thickness cartilage loss medial patellar facet without full-thickness cartilage defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Horizontal oblique flap tear posterior horn and body medial meniscus with extrusion of the flap of meniscal tissue into the coronary recess.

MRI of right Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

> The contour of PCL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
> Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of ACL, R/O grade 1 injury.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to contusion.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Increased fat stranding over infrapatellar fat pad
> Focal increased signal intenisty of patellar cartilag with fissure,in favor of grade3 patellar chondromalacia 
> Wearing of articular cartilage of rigth knee, major at medial compartment and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar andlateral plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impression: 
1. Nearly full thickness tear of PCL; differential diagnosis of high grade partial tear of PCL with ganglion cyst.
2. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; R/O parameniscal cyst; differential diagnosis of  MCL bursitis.
3. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
4. C/W osteoarthritis of right knee joint and mild synovitis.
5. Infrapatellar fat pad edema.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation
